a_priori_prediction: Candidate medians are non-increasing in cost; COST_ROBUST at conservative_2x (>= half the zero-cost robust assets, positive candidate-minus-null gap). severe_4x / extreme_10x locate the breaking point.

classification_rule.edge: verdict REGIME_STABLE and all segment medians > 0
classification_rule.gap: median(all candidate segment medians) - median(all null segment medians)
classification_rule.headline: COST_ROBUST if E(conservative_2x) >= max(2, ceil(E(zero)/2)) and gap(conservative_2x) > 0; COST_FRAGILE if 1 <= E(conservative_2x) < that threshold or gap <= 0; COST_ERASED if E(conservative_2x) == 0
classification_rule.robust_assets: assets with EDGE at >= 2 of the 3 lookbacks

determinism.scope: AMZN/JPM rerun at all cost levels
